name: Deal
description: A deal for everyone who joins, for example free beer for the first hour.

name: League
description: Points are collected over several nights, and there is an overall winner at the end.

name: Prize
description: There are prizes for the best teams.

name: Book online
description: Reserve your spot through the venue's online booking page.

name: Drop-in
description: Just show up. Booking is optional.

name: Sign up at door
description: You sign up when you arrive. Reservations are not possible.

name: First come first served
description: Spots go to whoever signs up or arrives first, so come early.

name: Email sign-up
description: Sign up by email with your team name and number of players.

name: SMS sign-up
description: Sign up by sending a text message to the venue.

name: Instagram DM sign-up
description: Sign up by sending the venue a direct message on Instagram.

name: Online sign-up
description: Sign up through a button on the venue's website.

name: Tickets
description: You buy a ticket for each player on your team.

name: No sign-up
description: No sign-up needed. Just turn up.
